notes.title: Development Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089000/03246e7bc34678e4f24cd7005662a21b7a04972d.png[/img]

[b]!!!Pickle Development Roadmap!!![/b]

Hello everyone, we're excited to finally share with you the development roadmap for our pickle game. The roadmap is designed to keep you in the loop about your development priorities and give you a glimpse of what’s on the horizon. Let's break down what to expect:

[b]Immediate Updates :[/b]
Starting from today, you will see consistent item releases. A new "common" pickle will be released every two days, providing fresh pickles to farm regularly. In addition to this, you can look forward to rare pickles making an appearance once a week. For those who crave something truly special, keep an eye out for special and ultra-rare pickles, which will be released periodically or given away during community events.
For more info about special pickles feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/y3RyQ5B844]Discord[/url]

[b]Coming Next: The new Horizon[/b]
In the next couple of months, we're rolling out a host of new features that will make your experience in Pickle even more engaging:

Rarity Tags for Categorization: Organize your pickle collection more effectively with new rarity tags.

New In-Game Animations and Features: Expect more dynamic and visually appealing gameplay as we introduce new animations and features.

Item Store Featuring Premium Content: Get ready to explore our new item store where you can access exclusive premium content.

We're also placing a strong emphasis on Community Involvement. We’ll be providing consistent development updates via Discord, offering new roles, hosting giveaways, and potentially collaborating with brands for unique deals.

[b]Future Ideas [/b]
Looking further ahead, we're planning even more exciting additions, though these don’t yet have a set release date. These include:

In-Game Inventory System: Manage your pickles and items more efficiently with an inventory system.

Trade-Up Feature: Swap out lower-tier items for a chance at something better with the trade-up feature.

More Hidden Easter Eggs: We’ll be adding more hidden surprises throughout the game for you to discover.

This roadmap is just the beginning. Your feedback is crucial as we continue to shape the future of Pickles. We can’t wait for you to experience these updates and are excited to see how the game evolves with your continued support.

notes.title: Big news
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have some exciting news to share about our game. 🎉 We’ve just added two new common pickles: the "Runevoid Pickle" and the "Brickle". We hope you enjoy these fresh additions!

Looking ahead, we have some big plans in the works. We're currently developing a roadmap to outline our upcoming features and improvements. Stay tuned for more updates and details!

In the meantime, we’d love to have you join our[url=https://discord.gg/y3RyQ5B844] Discord community[/url]. It’s a great place to stay connected and share your feedback.

Thanks for your continued support and happy gaming!
